integrity: Analytical proof supplied, exact rational example and reproducible deterministic tests; no independent verification or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to a fixed two-dimensional exact-arithmetic bilinear saddle skew-resolvent map; excludes Halpern anchoring, general ADMM, multi-mode systems, finite-precision sensitivity, stochastic noise and nonlinear problems.
title: Sharp relaxation and two-step nilpotence for a planar skew-resolvent saddle iteration
